name: rpg-de-mesa
description: Plataforma de RPG de mesa com múltiplas ambientações, dados e fichas in-game, single/multiplayer e Mestre humano ou IA.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rpg/shared && npm run build -w @rpg/server && npm run build -w @rpg/client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @rpg/server" "npm run dev -w @rpg/client"
